wizard.title: Migrate apps
wizard.intro: Inspect this server's running apps and adopt them into Openship. It's read-only — nothing changes on the server until you deploy.
wizard.flatDockerHint: Ignore Openship labels — adopt everything (incl. Openship-managed containers) as plain Docker.

edgeReview.handoff: Review the matched domains below. Migration sets up the target server's edge and asks for confirmation if an existing proxy needs to be replaced.

wizard.crossServerBuiltInfo: Locally-built images are streamed to the target as data (no registry, no rebuild). Large images take longer — a progress bar shows the transfer.
wizard.killOriginals: Stop & remove old containers once the new deployment is verified

plan.title: Transfer plan
plan.conflictDesc: These services' volumes already exist on the target. Choose what to do with each:

steps.sourceHint: Optionally link a repo and map your containers to its compose services — the running image is still reused.
steps.linkRepoDesc: Use Git for future rebuilds and auto-deploys.
steps.repoUrlInvalid: Enter a GitHub repo as owner/repo or a github.com URL.
steps.mapHint: Match containers to their services in the repository.
steps.noComposeFound: No docker-compose found in this repo — the repo links at the project level.
steps.mapNoRepo: Link a repository to map discovered containers to its services (optional).
steps.mapSkipHint: Linking a repo is optional — skip to continue (the running image is reused as-is).
steps.repoConnectHint: Connect GitHub in the panel to browse your repositories — or paste a repo URL.
steps.repoOnSourceHint: Link a repository in the next step.

run.title: Migrating your stack
run.moving_data: Moving volume data to the target…
run.awaiting_cutover: The new deployment is live — verify it, then finish
run.rolled_back: Rolled back — your original containers were restarted
run.routeHint: Your services are private until routes are configured. Add or review their domains in the project’s Domains tab.
run.downtimeNote: Selected source containers stop while data is copied and the destination starts. Plan for downtime.

cutover.title: Finish migration
cutover.warning: The destination is live. You can remove the original containers or keep them stopped. Source volumes are kept.
cutover.warningRestart: The destination is live. Keep originals restarts previously running source containers as independent copies. Remove originals retires them. Source volumes are kept.

discover.buildBlocked: Built from source — can't migrate yet (publish an image first)
discover.proxyExcluded: Reverse proxy ({ports}) — not imported; Openship’s edge replaces it.
discover.edgePortReserved: Ports {ports} reserved for Openship’s edge; not published.
discover.nothing: No adoptable Docker containers were found on this server.
discover.otherComposeHint: Part of {group} — add a separate project to import it
discover.emptyProject: No services selected yet — pick from the left.
discover.volumeCopyHint: Take over reuses the existing volume in place. Copy duplicates it into a new Openship volume and leaves the original untouched (uses extra disk).
discover.envFromImageHint: Not imported as config — the image supplies these at runtime. Import them to pin the values before you rebuild from source.
discover.alreadyManaged: {count} container(s) already managed by Openship were skipped.
discover.chooseHint: Select a Compose project or individual services.
discover.selectionKeyboard: Press Enter or Space to select a service.

reimport.title: Openship projects found
reimport.intro: These Openship projects are running on this server but aren't in this instance (a reset database, or a server from another Openship). Re-import to recover them — the original id is preserved so the live containers re-attach.
reimport.alreadyManaged: {n} container(s) are already managed by this instance.
reimport.finalizeNote: Re-import restores the project and re-attaches the running containers live — no redeploy needed. Redeploy only to change the build.
reimport.recoverHint: Restore its settings and reconnect the running containers.
reimport.checkSettings: Build settings may need review after recovery.
reimport.chooseHint: Select a project to recover its settings and running services.

entry.cardDesc: Migrate a running Docker or Compose deployment into Openship.

tab.emptyDesc: Move a running Docker or Compose stack from this server into Openship, or bring one in from another server.
tab.confirmCancel: Cancel this migration? The transfer stops and any changes on the target are rolled back.
tab.confirmDelete: Delete this migration record? The log is removed — your project and its data are untouched.
tab.safetyBody: Data is copied. Selected source containers stop during transfer; their data stays on the source. Removing original containers requires your approval.

sources.title: Connect a migration source
sources.empty: Connect the server you want to import from.
sources.hint: For migrations only. Remove the connection when you're done.
sources.importHint: Copy apps and data to a managed Openship server. Keep the source until you confirm cutover.

review.title: Review services
review.hint: Review access and data before migration.
review.finishRouteHint: Complete the domain and port, or choose Internal only.
review.destinationNext: Choose where to run these services next.
